title: A Lean~4 Framework for the Radii Polynomial Method
summary: Computer-assisted proofs in dynamics establish results about nonlinear systems by rigorous numerical computation. Their correctness rests on a trusted base of interval-arithmetic libraries and analytic estimates checked by hand. We formalize in Lean~4 a framework for the radii polynomial method, which certifies an exact solution near a numerical approximation by verifying four norm bounds and the resulting polynomial inequality.
